application: This application is a Provider Enrollment and Management (PEM) module within a Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS), designed to support state Medicaid agencies in managing the full lifecycle of healthcare provider enrollment, compliance, and reporting. The system operates through both daily and monthly batch processing cycles, handling the intake of new provider applications, risk-based screening and background checks, sanctions management, and federal revalidation enforcement in accordance with 42 CFR 455 requirements. It maintains a VSAM-based Provider Master file as its core data store, supporting key enrollment and sanctioning workflows. The application also includes an online component enabling state analysts to verify provider enrollment status in real time. On a monthly basis, the system generates required data submissions to the federal T-MSIS reporting system and performs month-end database maintenance. Supporting functions include provider directory management and legacy background check processing. Together, these components ensure the state Medicaid program meets federal screening, enrollment, and reporting obligations while maintaining accurate and up-to-date provider records.
